policy: A landlord must return a tenant's security deposit within 21 days after the tenant vacates and returns the keys. If the landlord fails to return the deposit within that period, the landlord forfeits the right to retain any portion of it and must return the full deposit.
scenario: Tomas vacated his apartment and returned the keys to the landlord on March 1. The landlord mailed the deposit refund check, postmarked April 5, 35 days later. The lease was a standard residential lease with no special clauses.
question: Is the landlord entitled to retain any portion of the security deposit?
